description: codex-acp 2.10.0 (Codex 0.171.0) reports MCP servers that did not start as failed tool calls (McpStartupReporter, dist/index.js:42387-42420), shapes from recorded runs: one right after the session/new answer, before any prompt (a server whose process exits at once), one in the middle of the turn (a server that never answers, after Codex's 30 s start-up timeout), with a failed update for the same id; session/new must carry _meta.mcpStartupAwaitTimeoutMs 10000

content.text: [codex-acp forwarded startup error] MCP server `fails` failed to start: MCP client for `fails` failed to start: MCP startup failed: handshaking with MCP server failed: connection closed: initialize response: connection closed: initialize response
